## Overview

Unlocks `--attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"fp8"}'` for MiniMax-M3 on ROCm gfx942 (MI300-series, CDNA3). gfx950 (MI350-series) keeps its fp8 routing through the AITER indexer, and CUDA behavior is unchanged.

## Claims

- fp8 indexer cache now selects on gfx942: Triton scorers get an e4m3**fnuz** cache instead of bf16, with correct saturation in both index-cache writers.
- +32% KV cache capacity for the same GPU memory.
- Serving throughput is neutral at short context and better at long context; GSM8K is unchanged.
- gfx950 keeps the pre-patch routing (fp8 via the AITER indexer, e4m3fn/OCP convert); NVIDIA keeps e4m3fn, `constexpr` 448.

## Validation

8x MI325X (gfx942), nightly `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-rocm100-39983a5e`, `EmbeddedLLM/MiniMax-M3-FP8-dynamic`, TP4, `ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN`, `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, `--max-model-len 262144`.

Indexer selection from serve logs:

| run | log line |
|---|---|
| before | `MiniMax M3 indexer: selected Triton (no fmha_sm100) [topk_blocks=16, indexer_kv_dtype=bf16, sm100=False]` |
| after | `MiniMax M3 indexer: selected Triton (no fmha_sm100) [topk_blocks=16, indexer_kv_dtype=fp8, sm100=False]` |

KV cache (same `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.92`):

| | KV tokens | max concurrency @ 262k |
|---|---|---|
| before | 4,554,368 | 17.37x |
| after | 6,020,992 | 22.97x |

`vllm bench serve` (openai-chat, random dataset, exact ISL/OSL, `--ignore-eos --temperature 0`, N=32/48/16/8, median):

| ISL/OSL/conc | Out tok/s | Δ | TTFT p50 (ms) | Δ | TPOT p50 (ms) | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8k/1k/8 | 468.6 → 470.4 | +0.4% | 3540 → 3519 | −0.6% | 13.95 → 13.93 | −0.1% |
| 8k/1k/16 | 697.4 → 700.4 | +0.4% | 4359 → 4365 | +0.1% | 18.85 → 18.66 | −1.0% |
| 32k/1k/8 | 284.2 → 290.0 | +2.0% | 9945 → 9830 | −1.2% | 18.43 → 17.98 | −2.4% |
| 128k/1k/4 | 92.6 → 96.3 | +4.0% | 21587 → 21104 | −2.2% | 22.12 → 20.94 | −5.3% |

GSM8K (lm-eval 0.4.13, `local-chat-completions`, 8-shot, chat template, temp 0, 1319 samples):

| | strict-match | flexible-extract |
|---|---|---|
| before | 94.69% ± 0.62 | 94.62% |
| after | 95.00% ± 0.60 | 94.92% |

Kernel tests on gfx942 (`tests/kernels/test_fused_minimax_m3_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py`, `tests/kernels/attention/test_minimax_m3_fp8_triton_indexer.py`): **61 passed, 32 skipped (nvfp4-only), 0 failed**, including the new insert-saturation, foreign-flavour-rejection, and fp8-vs-bf16 top-k equivalence tests. 

<details>
<summary>Reproduce</summary>

```bash
# after (before: omit the last flag)
export HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=0
vllm serve EmbeddedLLM/MiniMax-M3-FP8-dynamic \
  --served-model-name minimax-m3 --tensor-parallel-size 4 --block-size 128 \
  --max-model-len 262144 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 --max-num-seqs 32 --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --async-scheduling --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --language-model-only \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN \
  --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"fp8"}'

vllm bench serve --backend openai-chat --base-url http://localhost:8000 \
  --endpoint /v1/chat/completions --model minimax-m3 \
  --dataset-name random --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1024 \
  --ignore-eos --temperature 0 --num-prompts 32 --max-concurrency 8 \
  --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el --metric-percentiles 50,90,99 \
  --save-result --result-dir . --result-filename result.json

pip install "lm-eval[api]"
lm_eval --model local-chat-completions \
  --model_args base_url=http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions,model=minimax-m3,num_concurrent=16,tokenized_requests=False \
  --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 8 --apply_chat_template \
  --gen_kwargs temperature=0,max_gen_toks=1024 --output_path gsm8k_out

python -m pytest tests/kernels/test_fused_minimax_m3_qknorm_rope_kv_insert.py \
  tests/kernels/attention/test_minimax_m3_fp8_triton_indexer.py -v
```
</details>

## Details

Root cause, three pieces:

- `select_indexer_impl_cls` refused `indexer_kv_dtype="fp8"` on every ROCm platform, although the Triton scorers are flavour-agnostic (fp8 x fp8 accumulated in fp32).
- The index cache was pinned to e4m3**fn** (`torch.float8_e4m3fn`), which gfx942 cannot convert.
- The fused qknorm/rope/kv-insert writer picked its convert with `#if defined(HIP_FP8_TYPE_OCP)` — the macro is always defined (to 0 or 1), so gfx942 took the OCP branch and emitted OCP-labelled bytes that read back as wrong fnuz values (e.g. 1.1 -> 1.0, 0.77 -> 0).

The fix: the cache takes `current_platform.fp8_dtype()` (fnuz on gfx942, fn on gfx950/CUDA as before), the selector admits fp8 on ROCm gfx942 via the platform's `on_gfx942()` predicate, and the writer picks the flavour per target (`__gfx942__` -> fnuz) with saturation at `quant_type_max_v` (224 for fnuz, 448 for e4m3fn). Host checks expect the device's own flavour via the existing `is_fp8_ocp()`, and the Triton index-cache insert (AITER sparse-PA path) saturates at the same bound instead of producing NaN for out-of-range keys. gfx950's fp8 path keeps going through the AITER indexer (`SUPPORTED_ARCHS=("gfx950",)`), selected before this fallback is consulted.

Not a duplicate: the closest open PRs touching this area (#60930 CuTe prefill scorer, #59979/#59980 FMHA/MSA) are NVIDIA-side work; none enable the fp8 index cache on gfx942

AI assistance (GLM5.3-Flash) was used during the creation of this PR
